config.optimizer: full-batch Adam, lr .02, fresh moments at each branch
config.growth: clone unit, half outgoing coefficient, opposite input-weight perturbation
config.controller: residual-weighted input second moment times tanh second derivative, minimum eigenvector
config.validation_gate: paired holdout loss improvement >1.96 estimated standard errors; heuristic normal approximation, no claimed finite-sample guarantee
config.oracle: known population negative-label axis; separate privileged diagnostic
config.evaluation: exact uniform finite input population and true conditional label probabilities; training and validation labels sampled IID
config.selection: no test labels/population parameters to learned spectral or random controller
config.fixed_control_warning: For stationary regimes no pretraining was executed, so equal-step/equal-compute labels apply after excluding presteps; fixed controls currently use presteps argument 0 there
config.measurement_warning: operation-count proxies, not measured FLOPs; only total wallclock measured
